description: Discover which Bitcoin on-chain metrics exist. Returns every public chart with id, title, one-line blurb, category and formula. Call this FIRST to find a chart id (e.g. "mvrv", "exchange", "whale"), then use describe_chart / get_chart / get_latest with that id. Read-only, no side effects; the human page of each chart is https://kotecharts.com/c/{id}.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring matched against id, title, blurb and category, e.g. "sopr" or "Exchange". Omit to list all.

name: list_charts
title: List charts
